dct_description_sm:
Employment areas are areas designated in the Livable Oakville Plan (official plan) for clusters of business and economic activities including, but not limited to, manufacturing, warehousing, offices, and associated retail and ancillary facilities.


Note: The Employment Areas dataset replaces the previously posted Employment Districts dataset, which was derived from the old official plan and was not consistent with the new Livable Oakville Plan.
